CONVERSATION.NAME: Get Claire out of the way
CONVERSATION.DESCRIP: Get Claire to get out of the way of her parents selling Sara the Beanery.

CARD.NAME: Get over yourself.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Get over yourself. I know you were the one who chased down Sara.

CARD.NAME: I do actually know someone...
CARD.DESCRIPTION: God knows why, but I do actually know someone who has a crush on you. A guy, even.

CARD.NAME: I have a name for your...
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I have a name for your new clothing line: Tres Vominique

CARD.NAME: I hear you're actually...
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I hear you're actually a really good poet.

CARD.NAME: If you had a design studio
CARD.DESCRIPTION: If you had a design studio, would it be called Bitch Stitch?

CARD.NAME: If you were really...
CARD.DESCRIPTION: If you were really such a bad-ass bitch as you claim to be, you wouldn't give a damn what anyone else thought of you.

CARD.NAME: Look, if you let your parents...
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Look, if you let your parents sell Sara the Beanery, I bet she'll give you a little space to sell your stuff.

CARD.NAME: No one CARES
CARD.DESCRIPTION: No one CARES that you had a fling with a girl! It's not like you'll get a scarlet "L".

CARD.NAME: Open your heart
CARD.DESCRIPTION: If you could open your heart like you open your wallet, you'd actually get somewhere in life.

CARD.NAME: Sara was nothing but...
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Sara was nothing but sweet and loving to you. You just can't deal with your own emotions.

CARD.NAME: Stick to spending Mommy
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Stick to spending Mommy and Daddy's money. Everyone knows your designs are a joke.

CARD.NAME: The empress has no style.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: The empress has no style.

CARD.NAME: The only reason they sold...
CARD.DESCRIPTION: The only reason they sold your clothes at Pretty Vacant was because they didn't want to lose your business.

CARD.NAME: You know what?
CARD.DESCRIPTION: You know what? I do like Sara. You used to, too. Deal with it. (Makes all your dialog that increases unsure stronger).
CARD.EFFECT_DESCRIBED: +1 to all my cards of unsure,

CARD.NAME: Everyone loves me.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Everyone loves me. They just can't help themselves.

CARD.NAME: I am NOT a poet
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I am NOT a poet, and I know it! (Oh...)

CARD.NAME: I don't need anyone's love or approval
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I don't need anyone's love or approval. I do what I want. (All Claire's cards which decrease unsure are stronger)
CARD.EFFECT_DESCRIBED: -1 to all my cards of unsure,

CARD.NAME: I don't want to disappoint Prince William.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I don't want to disappoint Prince William. He was so looking forward to being my spokesdog.

CARD.NAME: If I don't open a boutique
CARD.DESCRIPTION: If I don't open a boutique, then where will all the Chihuahuas get their sweaters and tiaras? If they freeze to death it's your fault!

CARD.NAME: Me? A poet?!?
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Me? A poet?!? You take that back NOW!

CARD.NAME: My clothes RULE!
CARD.DESCRIPTION: My clothes RULE! Everyone says so.

CARD.NAME: Of course you don't want...
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Of course you don't want me to have a clothing line. It's not like any of it would even fit you.

CARD.NAME: Sara? Please.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Sara? Please. She reeks of chai and milk foam. Not that I ever got close enough to sniff her, of course.

CARD.NAME: What, are you in love with me, too?
CARD.DESCRIPTION: What, are you in love with me, too?

CARD.NAME: Where do you get your clothes?
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Where do you get your clothes? Free with 10-gallon purchase?

CARD.NAME: Why should I do anything nice for Sara?
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Why should I do anything nice for Sara? She'll just treat you like she treated...um, I wouldn't know anything about her personal life.

CARD.NAME: You are so captivated...
CARD.DESCRIPTION: You are so captivated by my beauty that you can't even see straight!
